It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Arizona Cardinals +6.5 with a fair total of 44.3 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Seattle Seahawks pass offence vs Arizona Cardinals pass defence, which sits +0.230 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
